# Platinum set for biggest monthly gain in 39 years on EU auto policy boost

By Ashitha Shivaprasad and Pablo Sinha

December 30, 2025 3:28 PM UTC Updated December 30, 2025

Save article Platinum set for biggest monthly gain in 39 years on EU auto policy boost

Platinum bars are stacked at the safe deposit boxes room of the ProAurum gold house in Munich, Germany March 6, 2014. REUTERS/Michael Dalder/File Photo Purchase Licensing Rights, opens new tab

- Spot platinum up 146% so far this year
- Prices hit a record $2,478.50/oz on Monday
- Platinum's fundamentals remain robust, analyst says

Dec 30 (Reuters) - Platinum prices are on track for their strongest monthly rally in nearly four decades in December, fuelled by the EU's U-turn on its 2035 combustion-engine ban, a tight supply backdrop and rising investment demand for precious metals.
